answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops fake identities at the inlet where agents enter the market. To claim a slot, an agent burns 600 POA, twice its 30-day earnings, and the slot lasts 20 epochs. Honest agents treat the slot as a haven: they pay once and recover the cost from fees. Making 100 identities burns 60,000 POA with no refund, since each fake slot needs an uncopyable onyx badge. One real agent pays once; a hundred fakes pay a hundred times.
